notes: Fresh prompts keep prefix-cache hits from inflating prefill speed.

name: Image removals through the coordinator
what_changed: The DS line sends tag + reference check, the coordinator runs the plain docker rmi and logs it.

name: Prefer in-process A/B/A/B blocks over separate starts
what_changed: Where a lever has a runtime switch, compare arms in alternating blocks inside one server process instead of separate starts.
why: Start-to-start spread on the same config is ~1-1.5 %.
metric: mb c8 tok/s, same config, two starts
notes: pct computed, this is the noise floor, not a lever effect.

name: Every lever gets a LEVERS.md row
what_changed: Each lever has a row in LEVERS.md (switch, exact or not, numbers with their reference, status), a result not written there is not kept.
why: User 9.11.: speed up the dev loop without losing good changes.

name: Capture the engine log from container start
what_changed: Start (docker logs -f ... | gzip) right after the container comes up and read the .gz, check applied-line counts against the windows before trusting a window map.
why: Docker json-file logs rotate at 5 x 100 MB, so a docker logs taken at the end returns only the tail.
notes: 211's broken windows were probably the same cause.

name: Delete mock sandboxes at once, check /tmp inodes
what_changed: Each builder deletes its /tmp/mockrad sandbox as soon as the report is read (max 2 at a time), disk checks include df -i, guards refuse above ~80 % inodes.
why: ~51k files x 21 sandboxes exhausted gpu02's /tmp tmpfs inodes (1,048,576, 100 %), and containerd could not mount: four FN items failed to start.

name: Shared n-gram table reuse for DeepSeek test starts
what_changed: New DS items mount the shared n-gram tables from /dev/shm (ngshare.sh) instead of copying them at every start.
notes: pct computed. c8 +1.7 %, c1 +2.4 %, 64k TTFT -0.5 % (within spread), first fill 308 s once, tables hold ~103 GiB of /dev/shm, so run the cleanup before any production start.

name: No baseline re-runs
what_changed: Production reference numbers come from existing results, only new arms run, and a missing reference is reported and asked about.
notes: Reference example: 3.11. fXYB24 s1 / s2 / s3 = 343.5 / 326.5 / 362.2 tok/s aggregate, u24 forced.

name: No Claude Code (cc_sim) comparisons for now
what_changed: Decisions rest on mb, prefill, in-process A/B blocks, identity and BetterBench, new items carry no cc_sim phase unless the user asks.
why: User 10.11.: does not trust cc tests.

name: Two new arms run as same-seed pairs with alternating order
what_changed: Two new arms are run as pairs on the same seed, with the order alternated between seeds.

name: No soak: decode before prefill, A B B A order, log card temperature
what_changed: After a start run decode blocks before prefill, put the mb window before the prefill window in each A/B block, keep A B B A so a linear drift cancels, and log junction + full-power sclk next to every prefill result.
why: Prefill is clock-bound at 210 W and drifts while the cards warm, decode does not move.
notes: Later extended: ABBAABBA where more blocks are needed (TESTING.md:119).

name: Coordinator-only queue copies
what_changed: Only the coordinator copies items into the gpu02 queue and logs it, builders stage items and hand back the cp line + md5s + checked sort position, a denied copy is never retried by another route.
why: User 12.11.: the coordinator manages the queue.

name: Refusal probes must use a switch value that stays invalid
what_changed: Bodies that post exl3_x3d 2 as a deliberate refusal probe move to exl3_x3d 5 before running on a K25U image.
why: The K25U plugin makes exl3_x3d 2 / 3 / 4 valid, so the old probe would return 200 and set the switch.

name: Open-loop replay only for arms of near-equal capacity
what_changed: An open-loop replay pair is read only when both arms ran the reference's load (validity check: <= 5 % overlapped turns per arm, uncached-token ratio 0.9-1.1), unequal arms use closed-loop replay per user after its own A/A floor.
why: 139 (stack vs k4n) gave TTFT 0.0444x and decode 2.16x: a saturation artefact (k4n fell behind, prefixes were re-prefilled, TTFT became queue wait).
notes: 139: 170 of 219 requests started before the user's previous reply ended in k4n vs 2 of 219 on the stack, 135 VALID, 139 INVALID.

name: One results table with reference and % difference, progress every ~15 min
what_changed: Report aggregate tok/s, TTFT p50/p95, per-stream decode p50/p10 and errors vs the reference with % difference in one table, post progress + ETA at least every ~15 min in a window.

name: Restore production with the image pinned and check docker inspect
what_changed: A test script that exports RADIANCE_IMAGE must restore production with the image pinned (or env -u RADIANCE_IMAGE) and check docker inspect afterwards.
why: compose takes RADIANCE_IMAGE from the shell before .env, 5.11. production B came back on the PR image for ~1 min.

name: Same-prompt back-to-back 1u reads (no essay / code alternation)
what_changed: A 1u read set is warm-up + reads of the same prompt back to back, a lever pair is read inside one same-prompt run with matched stream MB a step.
why: Alternating essay and code switched the expert residency on every read.
notes: base = essay after code (136-137 MB a step, 19.2 ms), new = essay after essay (27 MB a step, 17.43 ms), code after essay streamed 332-373 MB a step.

name: Stack gets the full suite regularly, bisect if it loses
what_changed: Small clear gains go into the stack, which gets the full suite (mb, prefill, BetterBench, copy, cc natural pairs) e.g. once an evening, a losing stack is bisected.

name: Start-speed gate on every fresh server
what_changed: Every fresh server passes prodfc.py <url> 384 with a 21 ms/step limit, one restart if slow.
why: Fresh starts could land in a slow state (see HW-L22).

name: Start-state probe on every item, no poller restarts
what_changed: Windows run on the host tuning alone, as production does, each item's start-state probe is the evidence, and a start reporting slow or between for another reason is flagged at once.
why: The keepawake poller showed no effect under the host tuning (125).
notes: Poller row: HW-L23, host tuning: HW-L22.

name: Judge small decode levers on the step-log full-row p50, not mb tok/s
what_changed: Start with RADIANCE_LOG_STEPS=1 and read the p50 step ms of full-row steps (n_seq = c, n_tok = c x (1 + n_spec)) per block, ABBAABBA where more blocks are needed.
why: mb block spread hides 1-2 % effects.
notes: 213 read G16q as no change on mb (c16 B/A 0.974, overlapping blocks), 217's step log showed +2.0 % a full-row step at c16 and c8 with every block separated. One-arm block p50s 37.65 / 37.83 / 37.90 / 37.89 ms.

name: Measure a lever on the metric it targets first
what_changed: Decode levers at mb c4/c8/c16, prefill levers on prefill 16k/128k + mb pf, drafting levers on cc_sim natural, kernels in a one-card kernel bench before any engine run, no full suite per lever.

name: Fixed test order per server: start gate, mb phases, then load test
what_changed: Every server test runs (a) qgate.sh start check incl. 16k prefill and 1-user ms/step, (b) mb.py c4, c8, prefill and turns, (c) the load test, (b) is never skipped.
why: 5.11.: a PR window used an ad-hoc agent bench instead of a standard.
notes: The cc_sim load-test step was later suspended (ME-no-cc-for-now).

name: No wait loops on gpu02, pgrep patterns must not match themselves
what_changed: All waits run locally over ssh, a wait loop uses the bracket form pgrep -f "[m]ockrun.sh ..." or waits on a known PID with kill -0.
why: Five stale builder wait loops matched their own command line and ran ~7.5 h on gpu02.
notes: The 5 stale PIDs were left for the user (kill refused by the permission system).

name: Window quantum: matched-prompt sums and work-based windows
what_changed: Newcomer levers are read on matched-prompt sums from the step log, c8 / c16 verdicts for ~1-2 % levers use a work-based window or >= ~140 s windows, the 35 s aggregate is info only.
why: A 35 s c8 window holds a whole number of ~500 ms newcomer steps (~1.5 % each), and P12SPLIT counted a step starting just before the window end as whole.
